title: Raise research dispatch caps (github_runner 3->6, runner-pool in-flight 5->8) ONLY if the CI-DIET 24 h p90 of concurrent CI jobs stays <= 10
note: [2026-10-14 weekly planning] OPERATOR-APPROVED 2026-10-14, CONDITIONAL. Field read 2026-10-14 (scripts/research/research_compute.yaml): backends.github_runner.max_concurrent 3, github_runner_data.max_concurrent 2 (runner pool 3+2 = 5), limits.max_total_inflight 7; the 2026-10-13 CAP MEASUREMENT (population: 4,176 runs, 288 5-min buckets) found CI p90 16 concurrent and the ~20 pool binding, so the caps were NOT raised then. CI-DIET (landed_unproven) trims the PR suite for data-only PRs; the condition is a 24 h re-measurement with the same method showing CI p90 <= 10. If it holds: github_runner 3->6 and the runner-pool in-flight 5->8 (max_total_inflight moves with it), one PR citing the measurement. If it does not hold: note the reading here and leave the caps.

observation.what: a 24 h re-measurement (same method as the 2026-10-13 CAP MEASUREMENT) is recorded here; if CI p90 <= 10 the caps read github_runner 6 / runner-pool in-flight 8 on main and the following 24 h shows no CI queue wait regression; otherwise the caps stay and the reading is noted
observation.how_to_check: scripts/research/research_compute.yaml on main + the measurement block in its header + comms/research/utilization
